You are adding two optional package fields in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no model call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: storygame/story_package/models.py, storygame/story_package/world_schema.py, tests/test_package_view_scope.py (new). Never edit data/, docs/, worker/, packages/, storygame/runtime/, other tests.

CONTEXT: worldkeeper (packages/worldkeeper/src/worldkeeper/model.py, finished, do not edit) now accepts two optional entity declarations in WorldSchema.from_data: `view` (a list of {from: <entity id>, blocked_by: {axis, pole} optional}) and `contents_complete` (bool); see its SchemaError checks and packages/worldkeeper/tests/test_view_and_scope.py. Story packages cannot declare them yet: the Item model in storygame/story_package/models.py has no such fields and storygame/story_package/world_schema.py (see how seat_for is passed through at about line 62) builds the schema dict from Item. Package authors need them so a story can say a vehicle can be seen into from an area, and that a searched place holds nothing else.

CHANGE: (1) Add to Item: `view: list[ItemView] = []` where ItemView is a small _Model with `from_` aliased to `from` (pattern _ID) and optional `blocked_by` model {axis: _ID str, pole: _ID str} (match how neighbouring models handle reserved names and extra='forbid'), and `contents_complete: bool = False`. (2) In world_schema.py pass them through to the worldkeeper item dict ONLY when set (omit `view` when empty and `contents_complete` when False) so existing packages produce byte-identical schema data. (3) Loader errors: an unknown `from` entity or unknown blocked_by axis/pole must surface as the package loader's normal StoryPackageError, not a raw worldkeeper SchemaError or a traceback; find how seat_for or other worldkeeper SchemaErrors are surfaced and mirror it. No story vocabulary in code.

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_package_view_scope.py (hermetic): copy data/stories/continuity-initiative to tmp_path and edit its world yaml in the test the way tests/test_seating.py does for its loader-rejection tests: (a) the unmodified package's world_source_schema_data output is identical before/after (assert against a captured literal hash computed in the test by calling the pre-existing helper on the real package and comparing it with the same call after loading from the copy, i.e. unmodified copy == real package); (b) a copy with `view` on the vehicle item (from: the outside area id, with a blocked_by naming an existing axis/pole) loads and the resulting World.sees(observer outside, laptop) is True while the shipped package gives False; (c) `contents_complete: true` on the drawer loads and World.contents_complete(drawer) is True, the shipped package False; (d) unknown `from`, unknown axis and a non-bool contents_complete each raise StoryPackageError. Discover the real entity ids from the package. Run them, see them fail, then build. FINISH: ruff check and ruff format every touched file; report pass counts.
